private.reauthentication_scope(text):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reauthentication_scope(p_operation text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case p_operation when 'secondary_password.replace' then 'secondary_password'
  when 'secondary_password.change' then 'secondary_password'
  when 'master.feature.set' then 'master_feature'
  when 'master.security_incidents.read' then 'master_security'
  when 'attendance.manage' then 'attendance_management'
  when 'master.security_collector.read' then 'master_security'
  when 'employee.bank.initial' then 'employee_bank_registration' end
$function$
private.sync_bank_document_status():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sync_bank_document_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or (not exists (
    select 1 from public.workers w where w.id = new.worker_id and w.company_id = new.company_id and w.user_id = auth.uid()
  ) and not (tg_op='INSERT' and private.has_company_feature(new.company_id,'can_manage_payroll') and exists(
    select 1 from private.employee_bank_initial_context c
    join private.reauthentication_proofs p on p.proof_hash=c.proof_hash
    where c.transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() and c.actor_id=auth.uid()
      and c.session_id=private.require_reauthentication_session()
      and c.company_id=new.company_id and c.worker_id=new.worker_id
      and c.input_sha256=private.employee_bank_initial_digest(new.company_id,new.worker_id,jsonb_build_object(
        'bank_name',new.bank_name,'branch_name',new.branch_name,'account_type',new.account_type,
        'account_number',new.account_number,'account_holder',new.account_holder))
      and p.actor_id=c.actor_id and p.session_id=c.session_id and p.operation='employee.bank.initial'
      and p.target=jsonb_build_object('company_id',c.company_id,'worker_id',c.worker_id,'input_sha256',c.input_sha256)
      and p.consumed_at is not null and p.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
  ))) then raise exception 'own bank account required'; end if;
  new.updated_at := now();
  insert into public.worker_document_statuses(company_id, worker_id, requirement_id, status, original_verified, updated_by, updated_at)
  select new.company_id, new.worker_id, dr.id, 'submitted', false, auth.uid(), now()
  from public.document_requirements dr
  where dr.company_id = new.company_id and dr.name = '銀行口座情報' and dr.is_active
  on conflict (worker_id, requirement_id) do update
  set status = 'submitted', original_verified = false, updated_by = auth.uid(), updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$function$
